purpose: Teach: 催眠/列挙/傾斜/海賊/聴覚/電磁波/服用/墜落

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、催眠商法による詐欺を取り締まっております
lines.en: We at the police department are cracking down on hypnosis-sales fraud schemes.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Formal register. Opens with steady official weight. Even pace, no hurry. The voice of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品を列挙して報告書をまとめました
lines.en: We've compiled a report with an inventory of all the seized items.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and procedural. Slight forward momentum as he moves through the list. No inflection—just clear information delivery. The tone of paperwork made audible.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、傾斜のある現場を警察、慎重に検証されたんですね
lines.en: So the police conducted a careful investigation of that tilted scene in the case.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. Slight upward lift on the question—seeking confirmation, not doubting. Soft, interested in the detail. The voice of someone thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、海賊版商品の摘発を進めております
lines.en: We're currently pursuing enforcement action against counterfeit goods operations.
lines.style: Steady procedural tone. Official formality maintained throughout. Mid-range pace, no urgency but no hesitation. Words land with clear weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、目撃者の聴覚情報を警察、参考にされましたか
lines.en: Did the police take the witness's acoustic observations into account for this case?
lines.style: Careful, slightly hesitant phrasing. Gentle curiosity underneath. Searching for confirmation rather than asserting. Trails softly on the question particle.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、電磁波を悪用する違法機器も調査中です
lines.en: We're also currently investigating illegal devices that misuse electromagnetic waves.
lines.style: Professional and continuous. Low urgency but steady focus. Each item listed with equal weight. The voice of someone working through a checklist methodically.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の薬服用歴を警察、確認されたんですね
lines.en: So the police did verify the suspect's history of medication use.
lines.style: Soft realization dawning. Gentle confirmation-seeking, not interrogative. Respectful of the officer's work. Quiet understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、墜落事故の現場検証を行いました
lines.en: We conducted a crime scene investigation at the crash site.
lines.style: Quieter and more direct. The formality eases slightly—closer to the human reality of the work. Still measured, but the weight has shifted from procedure to what was actually found.
